ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA bridge starts at net earnings (2021 Q3+: net earnings attributable to Vulcan) and adds back income tax, interest expense and the loss (earnings) on discontinued operations NET OF TAX before DDA&A, so published EBITDA is continuing-ops EBITDA; the schema check ni_vulcan+ebitda_bridge_tax+interest+total_dda=ebitda_pub therefore differs by ebitda_bridge_disc_ops (extra field, value as added); including it the check ties. adj_items.disc_ops is null (disc ops is not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). Adjusted EPS bridge: 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' is the after-tax per-share effect of all EBITDA adjustments. Business development = non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up -> adj_items.acquisition; COVID-19 direct incremental costs -> adj_items.other. Q4-21: Business development 8.4 in quarter (FY 39.0 incl. USCR acquisition related expenses 22.0 and inventory step-up 10.7 for the year per footnote; Q4 split not given separately). Pension settlement charge 12.1; restructuring 11.5. Release in $ millions. ROIC TTM = FY2021 14.2%. Same-store Aggregates cash gross profit/ton Q4-21 7.57 (FY 7.48) also published.
